title: Understanding Matrix Dimensions
text: When you decompose a matrix using PCA, the matrix $$V^T$$ is a transformation matrix. Its dimensions are determined by the number of features in the original matrix X. How many columns does X have?

title: Relating Dimensions
text: The matrix $$V^T$$ is derived from the original matrix X. Consider how the number of columns in X relates to the dimensions of $$V^T$$. What does this tell you about the number of rows in $$V^T$$?
